heroLead: Susquehanna Depot grew up around the old Erie Railroad yards, a town built by one industry a century before another one showed up underground, and both left their mark on how land here changed hands.
intro: Susquehanna Depot, often just called Susquehanna locally, is a small borough along the Susquehanna River, built historically around the Erie Railroad's repair shops and yards. Susquehanna County sits at the heart of the dry-gas Marcellus fairway, home to some of Cabot Oil & Gas's, now Coterra's, earliest and most productive Pennsylvania wells, and development has reached tracts in and around the borough over the years.

Because this area was so heavily leased so early, a lot of Susquehanna Depot families are dealing with leases signed back in 2008 or 2009, agreements that predate much of the legal clarity that later developed around post-production deductions.

sections.heading: Railroad History, Then Gas History
paragraphs: Land ownership around Susquehanna Depot often reflects the borough's railroad-era development pattern, smaller lots and parcels driven by the rail yard's footprint rather than large farm tracts. Even smaller parcels here can sit within an active drilling unit, since horizontal wells extend well beyond their surface pad.

sections.heading: What an Early, Long-Producing Lease Means for Value
paragraphs: If your family's lease dates back to the earliest years of the boom, we can usually work from over a decade of actual production data rather than a projection, which gives us a solid basis for a fair cash offer. We also check whether post-production deductions on your statement match what your specific lease actually permits.

faqs.question: Is my small borough lot still valuable even though it's not a large farm tract?
faqs.answer: Yes, if it sits within an active unit. Horizontal wells can extend more than a mile from their surface location, so lot size doesn't determine whether you have value.

faqs.question: How do I check if my early lease's deduction terms are still standard?
faqs.answer: We compare your specific lease language against your current royalty statement to confirm the deductions being applied are consistent with what you actually signed.

faqs.question: Has ownership of the wells near Susquehanna Depot changed over the years?
faqs.answer: In many cases, yes, Cabot Oil & Gas's assets became part of Coterra Energy following a 2021 merger. We can help confirm the current operator responsible for your royalty payments.

faqs.question: Does the old railroad history affect my current mineral title?
faqs.answer: Not typically, but older railroad-adjacent lots sometimes have unusual legal descriptions. We confirm your exact boundaries at the recorder of deeds before finalizing any offer.
